verdicts.reason: A is basically the original banner shrunk and dropped into the middle of the canvas. The building photo is a thin strip with huge dead white bands above and below it. The headline has been shoved left, so most of 'the limit' sits directly on the busy striped photo, which is an unwanted collision that hurts legibility. B makes the headline much larger as a strong three-line right-aligned stack, so the hierarchy is clearly better. But the photo is still a leftover cropped strip, the edge of 'the' clips its right side, and the bottom quarter of the canvas is empty, so it is unbalanced and not ship-ready.
